rivalDilemmaDefs.title: THE ENEMY CALLS
rivalDilemmaDefs.description: Your great rival's club triggers your release clause. Their sporting director says one sentence: come win everything next to him instead of against him. Your fans are already burning shirts preemptively.

choices.label: Join forces with your rival
choices.consequence: The most talked-about transfer of the decade. Signing bonus 10M, old fans furious

choices.label: Leak the offer and refuse
choices.consequence: Your fans crown you a legend of loyalty. Popularity +12, integrity +5

choices.label: Refuse quietly
choices.consequence: Nobody ever knows how close it came

rivalDilemmaDefs.title: THE TACKLE
rivalDilemmaDefs.description: Your rival went through your ankle in the derby, studs up, no ball. The referee gave a yellow. Your physio says you are fine. Your teammates want blood. The rematch is in May.

choices.label: Plot revenge for the rematch
choices.risk: 30% chance you see red doing it: popularity and morale -5

choices.label: Say nothing. Score twice in May.
choices.consequence: +1 Shooting next season, ice in the veins

rivalDilemmaDefs.title: THE DEBATE SHOW
rivalDilemmaDefs.description: A global sports network offers 2M for one live hour: you versus a panel of pundits arguing that your rival is better. No script, no edits, one microphone.

choices.label: Go on and cook them
choices.risk: 35% chance a clip goes viral badly: popularity -8

choices.label: Send a highlight reel instead
choices.consequence: The reel does the talking. Popularity +8

rivalDilemmaDefs.title: TRUCE FOR ONE NIGHT
rivalDilemmaDefs.description: Your rival's foundation asks you to co-headline a charity match for children's hospitals. Same pitch, same team, one night only. The photo of you two in the same shirt would break the internet.

choices.label: Play, and split the donation
choices.consequence: 1M donated, popularity +10, integrity +8, the feud softens

choices.label: Play, but start a playful nutmeg war
Send a check, skip the match
